reason: The Atlas/world-culture course direction is clear, but the exact Traveler's Atlas source corpus has not yet been recovered and reconciled into current Rex Fleet canon. Do not invent production pages merely to establish an issue count.
scope: Shard worlds, havens, trade and survival cultures
routes, ports, markets and travel assumptions
issueCountPolicy: Plan as a one-off by default. If the recovered Atlas corpus proves too broad for one coherent issue, use two or three tightly differentiated issues; do not build an open-ended regional survey.
intendedForm: Academy comparative geography/culture field course. Traveler/Atlas text can run as a caption/narrator lane while cadets visit, simulate, map, interview, and discover where a guidebook is accurate, incomplete, dated, regionally biased, or contradicted by lived reality.
sourceNeeds: Locate the exact Traveler's Atlas source text/edition referenced in prior worldbuilding.
Crosswalk it against World Codex & Shattering History, current Rex Fleet production canon, and Fandom reconciliation.
Separate durable place facts from superseded faction stereotypes and old naming.
Only then design issue modules and register a production show.

courseArchitecture.castScope: Choose an instructor/field cohort suited to this course rather than inheriting another Academy cast by default.
courseArchitecture.imgScope: Create a dedicated Traveler's Atlas IMG/reference project only when the course enters visual production.
